Date: Thu, 02 Apr 2026 11:30:41 -07:00
Subject: Internal: preliminary root cause — KV cache invalidation after deploy (Apr 2 09:00 PDT)

Laura / team — quick technical summary from triage:
- Timeline: anomalous deploy to serving mesh completed at 08:58 PDT; error-rate and throughput degradation observed 09:05–09:50 PDT.
- Symptom: sustained queueing at the frontend and a surge of 500/502 responses when cache misses exploded after an invalidation event.
- Likely cause: an aggressive KV cache invalidation path in the recent patch caused synchronous backend fallback for a high % of requests. The runtime then hit transient overload.

Mitigation already performed: we rolled back the deploy at 09:22 PDT which restored normal hit-rate and throughput by ~09:55 PDT.

Next steps (recommended):
1) Hotfix to make cache invalidation async + backoff (ETA 48h).
2) Add a short-term routing policy to send Stratus traffic to a warm pool for 7 days while the hotfix lands.
3) Post-incident RCA doc and permanent monitoring alerts (24–48h).

I attached our monitoring export for the incident window.

Attachments: stratus_monitoring_report_20260402.pdf

-Marissa
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

Team — based on the impacted window (09:05–09:50 PDT) and the contract terms (monthly availability SLA, per-token billing), here’s a conservative starting point for discussion:

- Impacted usage window: ~45 minutes on Apr 2.
- Proposed immediate remedy: prorated credit equal to 100% of charges during the impacted window + a one-time account goodwill credit of $15,000 to cover downstream customer impact and operational costs.
- Alternative (if legal pushes back): 25% monthly credit for April prorated, plus $8k one-time.

I’ve attached a spreadsheet with the raw numbers and how the prorate was calculated. We should review with Finance and Legal before sending externally.

Attachments: proposed_credit_calc.xlsx

If everyone is OK, I’ll draft the outbound language and proposed SLA amendment for signature.

Thanks,

Summary of actions:
- Root cause: aggressive KV cache invalidation triggered by a recent deploy; rollback restored service by 09:55 PDT.
- Technical remediation: hotfix to make invalidation async (ETA 48h), routing to warm pool for 7 days (already scheduled).
- Monitoring: we will add an SLA-focused Datadog monitor with webhook and weekly incident digests for your team.

Commercial proposal (initial):
1) Immediate credit: 100% credit for billable usage during the impacted window (Apr 2, 09:05–09:50 PDT), applied as a one-time account credit.
2) Goodwill: $15,000 one-time credit toward April billing.
3) Contract: we propose a short SLA amendment that documents the credit above and adds a clarified monitoring & notification clause (draft attached).

Next steps: please review the attached SLA amendment draft and the credit proposal. If acceptable, we will initiate a DocuSign for the amendment and schedule weekly incident updates until the hotfix is verified.
